name: getsonar-mcp
description: Company register lookups and KYB checks: registries, sanctions, PEP, offshore leaks, adverse media.
long_description: SONAR runs KYB (Know Your Business) due diligence on vendors, partners and resellers from public records: a live lookup in official company registers (exists, active, good standing, officers), sanctions and PEP lists, ICIJ Offshore Leaks and 10 years of adverse media, each finding naming its kind of source. A due-diligence aid, not a regulated AML/KYC provider. Pay per call: company lookup EUR 0.01 when found (100 free), /findings EUR 0.50, /run EUR 6.00; your first findings or report call is free. Requires uv (uvx) on the PATH.

tools.name: company_lookup
tools.description: Register check: exists, active, good standing (EUR 0.01 if found)

tools.name: company_officers
tools.description: A company's officers from its register (EUR 0.01 if found)

tools.name: kyb_findings
tools.description: KYB screening: sanctions, PEP, owners, adverse media (EUR 0.50)

tools.name: kyb_run_submit
tools.description: Submit a full KYB report, returns a run_id (EUR 6.00)

tools.description: Balance, free calls and free lookups remaining (free)
